svg.title: Queries without the shard key
svg.desc: An animation in four steps. Players are sharded by player id across four database servers, db-0 to db-3: hash(player_id) mod 4 places five players on each, and a router in front of them applies the same rule. Loading Lemur's profile names player 8577, so the router sends the query to db-1 alone, and db-1 answers with one row. The global top 3 by rating names no player, so the router asks all four servers at once, and each returns its own top 3. The router merges the answers as they arrive, but db-2 is busy and answers last. It holds Ferret, the best rating of all, so the leaderboard of Ferret, Newt, and Lemur is done only when that answer arrives.
svg.text: A query that names the shard key goes to one server. Any other query asks every server and waits for the slowest.
waiting for db-0, db-1, db-2, db-3
Players are sharded by player_id: hash(player_id) mod 4 places five of them on each server, db-0 to db-3.
Lemur's profile names player 8577, and hash(8577) mod 4 = 1, so the router asks db-1 alone. The other servers never see it.
The global top 3 by rating names no player, so the router asks all four servers at once, each for its own top 3.
The router merges answers as they arrive. Busy db-2 answers last and holds the best rating, so the leaderboard waits for it.
